verdict.rationale: LocalAI's getting-started docs state that it automatically detects the system's GPU (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) and downloads the matching backend. That directly covers running models on multiple GPU vendors with vendor-specific acceleration, and the distributed mode also supports adding GPU worker nodes. Missing for 10: explicit naming of the vendor kernels/backends (e.g., CUDA, ROCm, SYCL/oneAPI), in-depth hardware-acceleration documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of performance across vendors.
